choose.when: SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE ur.role_id = #{principalId} AND u.enabled = true
choose.otherwise: SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE u.enabled = true AND d.path LIKE (SELECT path FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{principalId}) || '%'
